point_pk_prepared.hypothesis: Shared rowid-name detector refactor affects per-execution code generation/inlining; equality succeeds before the new range fallback.

top10.hypothesis: Shared SELECT code-generation candidate; new range miss runs only five times with selection=None and cannot by itself explain14percent. TopK algorithm unchanged.

join_group_by_city.hypothesis: Indirect post-open allocation/cache state candidate; joined source bypasses the new range helper. No direct join/group implementation changed.

causality: Hypotheses before bisect, not established causes. Unchanged counters and user/system CPU diagnostics do not acquit or convict commits.
